curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to assess your own driving, why DMV may reexamine a driver, who refers drivers, how cognitive disorders affect driving, and what a reexamination can lead to.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card joining self-evaluation, referrals and DMV outcomes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a driver's situation and asks what DMV may do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the Notice of Priority Reexamination, the five-working-day contact window, what the notice rests on, and the non-compliance suspension.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the notice, its basis and the non-compliance rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a driver handed a priority notice.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover why restrictions exist, the kinds of restrictions DMV can impose, and why no restriction targets age.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each restriction rule; a contrast card linking notices and restrictions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a condition and asks which restriction could fit.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec12-m01..sec12-m03; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
